title: The Quest for Wisdom in Turbulent Times - Nautilus
gist: Four Harvard professors from religion, medicine/anthropology, theology and history have co-taught an undergraduate wisdom course for over a decade and distilled it into the book The Practice of Wisdom: Five Quests. The quests cover caregiving, solitude, self-understanding and transcendence as routes to living well in turbulent times.
